signatures.name: Unlimited ERC-20 Approval
signatures.description: Token approval set to max uint256. Any approved contract can drain the full token balance at any time.

signatures.name: Contract Address Recipient
signatures.description: Recipient is a smart contract. Sending PHRS without confirmed receive() function may result in permanent loss.
signatures.remediation: Verify contract ABI and confirm payable receive() before transferring.

signatures.name: Zero Balance — Gas Trap
signatures.description: Wallet has zero native PHRS. Cannot pay gas for any operation. All transactions will revert.
signatures.remediation: Fund wallet with minimum 0.01 PHRS for gas before any operation.

signatures.name: Dormant Wallet
signatures.description: Address has zero transaction history. Could be a fresh wallet, dust recipient, or abandoned address.
signatures.remediation: Verify address ownership before sending significant value.

signatures.name: Critically Low Gas Reserve
signatures.description: Native balance below 0.01 PHRS. Most DeFi operations require more than this for gas.
signatures.remediation: Top up native balance to at least 0.1 PHRS before executing DeFi operations.

signatures.name: High-Value Target
signatures.description: Wallet holds significant PHRS balance. Elevated risk of targeted phishing, social engineering, and approval exploits.
signatures.remediation: Review all active approvals. Consider hardware wallet for holdings above 100 PHRS.

positive_signals.name: Established Transaction History
positive_signals.description: Wallet has >50 transactions — consistent, long-term activity reduces risk profile.

positive_signals.name: Recently Active
positive_signals.description: Wallet has been active within the last 7 days — not dormant or abandoned.
